Hi Kara / Ben / Novus procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our discussion, attached is a clean redline of the DPA that includes the "no model improvement" (no-adaptive-training) commitment for the Novus pilot, along with a first-pass ops implementation checklist that maps contractual asks to engineering controls.

Two quick asks so we can move toward signature:
- Confirm scope: the no-improve commitment should apply to all inference requests from Novus tenant IDs (both interactive and API). Please confirm if you need any carveouts (e.g., aggregated telemetry for platform health).
- Residency / KMS: confirm preferred region for key custody (you mentioned US-EAST for production).

Next steps we propose if you sign off:
1) Legal: finalize DPA redline and agree DocuSign routing (we can route to your procurement contact).
2) Infra / Ops: implementation sprint (2 weeks) to enable routing to non-improving model variants + request tagging + audit logs + opt-out audit artifact delivery described in the checklist.
3) Pilot cutover & evidence: deliver the ops checklist and a short evidence pack (configuration snapshots, logs) for your security review.

I’ve copied David (privacy) and Kim (legal ops) to align the implementation items to owners. Attaching: NOVUS_DPA_redline_v1.docx and ops_implementation_checklist_v1.xlsx.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan

Thanks, Tessa — this looks good at a high level. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Scope: Novus confirms the no-improvement commitment should apply to all production tenant traffic from our environment (both synchronous API calls and any session-based interactions). We still expect operational telemetry (error rates, latencies) to be collected by Redwood for platform health; that is not allowed to be used for model training.
- Carveouts: we do not want aggregated/derived content used to improve models either. So please make sure the implementation plan explicitly separates any aggregated metrics from training pipelines.
- KMS: Novus prefers US-EAST (AWS us-east-2) and will require a customer-managed KMS key. We need confirmation of integration approach (KMS vs HSM).

Legal/procurement: I’ve looped in our procurement alias; we will route the DPA to our legal counsel for review. Do you have a suggested DocuSign order (e.g., Redwood legal -> Novus legal -> procurement)?

Finally, for evidence we’ll expect a short runbook and one-off artifacts for the pilot: config export, audit logs for a 48-hour sample window, and a checklist showing routing to non-improving model(s).

Kara Singh
Head of Security & Privacy
Novus Health

Thanks Tessa and Kara — I’ll lead the privacy/controls design and coordinate with infra. Quick notes on the high-level controls that map to the DPA clauses: 

1) Tenant-level routing: we will add a tenant flag (novus_tenant_id) that pins traffic to an enforcement path. That path will always use non-improving model variants (read-only weights, disabled telemetry hooks to training infra).
2) Data tagging & retention: all Novus requests will be tagged with a "no_improve" attribute upstream; retention windows will be set to 30 days for logs by default for the pilot, with the option to shorten per Novus ask.
3) Telemetry segregation: platform health metrics (latency, error rates) will be exported to our monitoring cluster but will be ingested only into metrics stores — they will not be forwarded to any training or model-improvement pipelines.
4) KMS: we support customer-managed KMS keys in AWS us-east-2 via our key-wrapping integration. Ops will need the Novus key ARN and an IAM role reference to test crypto operations.

Action items for internal owners: 
- Priyom: own infra changes (routing + flags + evidence export). Estimate: 2-week sprint with a short smoke test environment.
- Kim: own the DocuSign flow and legal ops; coordinate signature order and ensure redline is final.
- Tessa: confirm any commercial constraints (SLA, retention length) with Novus.

I’ll put together a short technical runbook and a sample evidence checklist that matches the items Kara requested. Priyom — can you confirm the sprint plan by EOD?

-David
David Kim
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
